description:
A thousand years have passed since the last princess of Balhalla destroyed her own country... and the price she had to pay for doing so? Live an immortal life in the body of a little, white ferret! 

One day, she meets a young man in a series of rather dire and tense events, and discovers that despite being human, he can understand her as a ferret. Not only that, the man claims that she is his first love, and he constantly and endlessly professes his love for her too, nothing but blissful that his dreams came true in meeting her. However, despite his gushing love for her, she decides to use him to finally bring an end to her cruel, undying life of one thousand years. 

A story full of ups and downs, twists and turns, as Soaz, King of Pallirod, and Noel, ex-sorceress and last princess of Balhalla, dive deep into a curse-breaking journey! 

(Source: POCKET COMCIS)
